headline: Switching to {arm:f64} saves {price.f64.prod.persona.monthly_cost_gap|abs} a month but stays in character {contrast.f64.persona.delta|abs|pts} points less often, with most of the loss in long conversations.
lede: On point estimates f64 is the only challenger inside both guardrails, and it loses character clearly ({contrast.f64.persona.interval|interval} points against {arm:prod}). Those readings are thin: f64 clears speculation narrowly, and {arm:f16} misses music facts by only {criteria.facts.f16.gap|abs|pts} points; if it clears that and holds speculation, it replaces f64 as Production's rival.
flag: Nothing declared before the run says what a point of staying in character is worth against cost, so the choice is the persona owner's to make.

caveats.material_if: Material if f64's true speculation rate sits under its floor: it clears by less than its change against Production could reach. Its music-facts clearance survives that same reading. If f64 fails speculation and f16 does not clear both guardrails, Production is the only option left and the trade becomes a decision to keep it.

Material if f16's true music-facts rate is at or above its floor and it holds speculation. It misses music facts by a fraction of a point, and its change against Production reaches back past that floor; its speculation clearance is thinner than f64's, and the same reading reaches under it. If it clears music facts and holds speculation, f16 replaces f64 as the cheaper side of the trade, and it brings a small loss on completing requested actions ({contrast.f16.task.delta|abs|pts} points, uncorrected, interval {contrast.f16.task.interval|interval}) as well as character.

Material only if the judge reads staying in character differently for one arm than another. Cost, the other side of the trade, is measured; the blind ratings point the same way but are too few and carry no interval, so they cannot stand in for calibration.

Material only if correcting across the {n_candidates|int} challengers moved a verdict that puts an option in or out. The losses that carry the call, f64's character and cor's speculation, sit well clear of zero; the guardrail readings for f64 and f16 are open on their own caveats already.

decision.text: Moving all traffic from {arm:prod} to {arm:f64} saves {price.f64.prod.persona.monthly_cost_gap|abs} a month at the declared volume and gives up {price.f64.prod.persona.gain|abs|pts} points of staying in character.

Production is the better buy if a point of staying in character is worth more than about {price.f64.prod.persona.monthly_per_point} a month, and f64 below that; the interval on the loss spreads that line from {price.f64.prod.persona.monthly_per_point_low} to {price.f64.prod.persona.monthly_per_point_high}. If f16 clears music facts and holds speculation, f64 drops out: moving from f16 to f64 costs {price.f16.f64.persona.monthly_per_point} a point a month, a gap with no interval of its own, and the line between f16 and Production sits near {price.f16.prod.persona.monthly_per_point}. That trade would also give up a little on completing requested actions.

Our lean, not a recommendation: keep Production until the guardrail re-run says which cheaper option is really on the table, and until a mix that hands long conversations to Production has been run. The judged loss sits mostly in long conversations, the part such a mix might keep; whether early turns from the cheaper model already set up that loss is untested. If the call can't wait, the price line above decides it.

f64 clears the speculation floor by {criteria.specul.f64.gap|abs|pts} points and the music-facts floor by {criteria.facts.f64.gap|abs|pts}; f16 misses music facts by {criteria.facts.f16.gap|abs|pts} and clears speculation by {criteria.specul.f16.gap|abs|pts}. The snapshot holds no interval on any arm's own rate, so the far end of each change against Production stands in for one. Read that way, f64's open floor is speculation only, while f16 could clear music facts and could also fall under speculation.

A re-run of f64's speculation cases and f16's music-facts and speculation cases, which fixes whether f64, f16 or neither faces Production; then a price per point of staying in character, declared by the persona owner.

claims.text: {arm:f64} stays in character {contrast.f64.persona.delta|abs|pts} points less often than {arm:prod}, clearly worse. It costs {price.f64.prod.persona.monthly_cost_gap|abs} less a month at the declared volume.

evidence.caption: Change in staying in character against Production, each challenger, with its interval.

claims.text: f64's gap to Production widens with every step in conversation length, to {strata.depth:11+.f64.persona.vs_control|abs|pts} points at 11+ turns. Conversations of 6–10 turns are {strata.depth:6-10.share|pct} of cases and carry {strata.depth:6-10.loss_share.f64.persona|pct} of f64's loss. Those of 11+ turns are {strata.depth:11+.share|pct} of cases and carry {strata.depth:11+.loss_share.f64.persona|pct}.

evidence.caption: Stays in character by conversation length in turns, Production and f64. A breakdown read after the fact, uncorrected: a lead, not a confirmed finding.

claims.text: As a lead only, blind raters' preference for Production over f64 looks stronger in long conversations than in short ones; the snapshot stores no interval and no count per length band.

evidence.caption: Share of blind ratings preferring Production over f64, by conversation length; half means no preference. The note gives the total count across both bands; no interval was stored, so the two bands may not differ.

claims.text: {arm:f16}, the cheapest option, misses the music-facts floor by only {criteria.facts.f16.gap|abs|pts} points on its point estimate, too thin to call, while f64 clears it narrowly. f16 is clearly worse than Production on music facts ({contrast.f16.facts.interval|interval} points), but that interval does not settle which side of the floor it sits.

explore.control: Price of one point of staying in character, per month
explore.binds: Production against f64, or against f16 if f16 clears music facts and holds speculation
explore.outcome: With f64 as the cheaper side, Production is the better buy above about {price.f64.prod.persona.monthly_per_point} a point a month, a line the interval spreads from {price.f64.prod.persona.monthly_per_point_low} to {price.f64.prod.persona.monthly_per_point_high}. With f16 as the cheaper side, the line sits near {price.f16.prod.persona.monthly_per_point}, spread from {price.f16.prod.persona.monthly_per_point_low} to {price.f16.prod.persona.monthly_per_point_high}.

Raised above {criteria.facts.f64.value}, the floor drops f64. Loosened to {criteria.facts.f16.value} or lower, it lets f16 in, provided f16 holds speculation, and f16 replaces f64 rather than joining it: moving from f16 to f64 costs {price.f16.f64.persona.monthly_per_point} a point a month, more than the f64-to-Production line, so at every price either f16 or Production is the better buy. That f16-to-f64 gap has no interval of its own.

Raised above {criteria.specul.f64.value}, the floor drops f64. Loosened to {criteria.specul.cor.value} or lower, it lets cor in, and cor would be the best buy from {price.f64.cor.persona.monthly_per_point} to {price.cor.prod.persona.monthly_per_point} a point a month, a band that covers the f64-to-Production line. It changes nothing at the declared floor: cor sits under it even at the top of its interval against Production, and a standing guardrail is not loosened by a report.

method.text: {scoreboard.prod.cases} cases per arm and {scoreboard.prod.ran} trials per arm; no trial was lost or failed on any arm.

{family.disclosure} No interval is stored on an arm's own rate, so a guardrail reading against its floor is a point estimate; where the page reads one as uncertain, the far end of the arm's change against Production stands in.
Staying in character and music facts are judged pass or fail per reply. Completing the requested action and declining to speculate are checked by code.

Standing guardrails read on each arm's mean: declining to speculate at least {criteria.specul.threshold}, and music facts correct at least {criteria.facts.threshold}. Staying in character, the asked aspect, has no declared margin or floor.
Which judge read the two judged aspects, and how it was calibrated, is not recorded in the snapshot.

Cost per 1,000 replies from the measured runs. Monthly figures are at the declared volume of {meta.volume_per_month|int} replies a month. A price per point is arithmetic on point estimates, printed to the cent though it is approximate; its band is read off the interval on the loss, and a move between two challengers has no band.
Conversation-length strata are read after the fact and uncorrected; they are leads.
Pairwise blind ratings of Production against f64 only, in two length bands; the block's note gives the total count. No interval or per-band count was stored.
No mix of models was run. Blind ratings cover f64 only. How runs were placed on machines is not recorded, so latency is read as reported.
Synthetic example campaign data, frozen as one report snapshot.

Money figures print to the cent, including the headline saving and the price lines. The reviewer asked for rounded figures; no figure-key filter rounds dollars (the whole-number filter is refused on dollar figures), so the cents stay, the prose says about or near, and each price line carries its band.
